content.value: Gathering Speed is the effective tool multiplier. World-tree Gathering Speed increases scale the tool base. Mining, Woodcutting and Digging Speed are extra percentage bonuses for their matching blocks. Suitable tools, harvest requirements, Haste and Mining Fatigue still matter. Specialized speed bonuses are capped at 300%.

Yield adds resources to the original loot result; it never rerolls the loot table. Bonuses add together before rounding. For example, 25% yield on four items adds one item; on one item it gives a 25% chance for an extra item. Combined yield is capped at 300%. Extra items split into legal stacks instead of disappearing above one stack.

Ore Yield affects tagged ore resources, including [[item/minecraft:ancient_debris|ancient debris]] scrap; Gem Yield adds for diamond, emerald and lapis. Dimension-specific ore bonuses add in their matching dimension.
Log Yield applies when chopping grown logs with an axe. Sapling Yield increases saplings and apples from manually harvested grown leaves.
Digging Yield increases clay balls and flint already dropped from natural gravel. [[item/minecraft:flint|Flint]] Yield adds to the flint bonus. Silk Touch blocks are not multiplied.
Crop and Seed Yield apply to mature crops harvested with a hoe, including cocoa and [[item/minecraft:nether_wart|Nether Wart]]. [[item/minecraft:carrot|Carrots]] and potatoes use Crop Yield.
Fortune-style yield bonuses add to the matching resource yield; they do not independently reroll the same loot.
Placing and breaking resource blocks does not generate extra materials. Properly grown trees and mature farm crops still benefit.

Crop Replant Chance can replant a mature crop after hoe harvesting. Each successful replant consumes one matching seed or planting item from the hotbar, regular inventory or an unlocked bag slot. It requires suitable soil, space and normal breaking permissions. No seed means no replant; locked bag slots and active trades are excluded. Sneak while harvesting to leave the space empty.

Item Rarity improves the chance of suitable higher-quality results in weighted loot, including eligible tome rewards. It does not directly upgrade equipment rarity or create an extra copy of every drop. A 25% bonus is not a guaranteed 25-percentage-point increase in drop chance.

World Discovery XP Bonus increases all personal first-discovery World XP rewards, up to 50% from this stat. Ordinary Experience Bonus still applies. Repeated discoveries do not pay again.
Tool Preservation combines with Durability Preservation to avoid durability loss, capped at 80% total. It does not repair an item.
Bonus Block Reach adds up to two metres of block interaction reach. It does not increase attack reach or bypass permissions or line of sight.
Swimming Speed increases player water acceleration by up to 50%. Breath Efficiency prevents up to 75% of underwater air-loss ticks.
Travel Efficiency reduces sprinting and swimming hunger costs by up to 50%; it does not alter combat, mining or mount stamina costs.
Vein Mining uses normal protected player breaks for at most 31 additional connected ores. Every block uses its own original loot result, durability cost and placement protection.

Riding Speed increases controlled mount speed. Riding Agility improves acceleration and braking without changing turning rate.
Mount Endurance reduces sprint stamina or ability-resource drain; jumps and camel dashes keep their normal costs. Mount Recovery increases positive stamina or resource regeneration after the normal delay.
Sure Footing reduces the mount's fall damage, separately from passenger damage.
Only the controlling rider supplies these bonuses. They never change genes, inherited traits, unmounted recovery or a following animal's speed. Speed, recovery and agility are not capped to suggested balance targets; stamina-cost and fall-damage reductions cannot exceed 100%.
